messages.subject: Force stop deployed shiny app from terminal
parts:
Hi all,

I would dearly appreciate some help. I've deployed an app from a remote computer via RStudio and then disconnected from it. When I reconnected I was expecting to pull up the old session but RStudio started a new session and I now can't stop the old app from broadcasting.
Is there a way of either restoring the old session to run stopApp() or killing the app from terminal on the remote computer (running Ubuntu 14.04)?

Thanks,
B
